Machine learning algorithms are categorized into three primary types based on their learning mechanisms and objectives:

1. Supervised Learning
This approach uses labeled training data to predict outcomes. The algorithm learns from input-output pairs to make predictions on new, unseen data.

2. Unsupervised Learning
This method identifies hidden patterns or intrinsic structures within input data without labeled responses. It is used for clustering and association tasks.

3. Reinforcement Learning
This type focuses on decision-making, where an agent learns to take actions in an environment to maximize cumulative reward through trial and error.
